step1_analysis.description: A dual-mode sensor front-end for an impedance sensor. It includes a current-mirror based driver for measuring external impedance (e.g., 50 ohms) on one side, and a cascode amplifier/comparator for signal conditioning on the other side.

paper_reference.title: An 87mA·min Iontophoresis Controller IC with DualMode Impedance Sensor for Patch-Type Transdermal Drug Delivery System

power_consumption.description: Total DC power consumption from the supply

sky130_expected.calculation: Tail currents (XM2, XM13) ~311uA each. Input branches ~57uA each. Total current ~750uA. Power = 750uA * 1.8V = 1.35mW.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Based on SKY130 typical Vth and mobility at 1.8V supply with 0.9V biases.

sensor_current.description: Current driven through the external sensor impedance at N3

sky130_expected.calculation: XM3 generates ~57uA, mirrored by XM9/XM8 to N3.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Depends on the bias voltage at LABEL_NET_1 (0.9V).

comparator_threshold.description: Input voltage at LABEL_NET_2 that causes the output N4 to switch

sky130_expected.calculation: Matches the PMOS bias N10 (0.9V) assuming symmetric sizing.
sky130_expected.reasoning: The trip point is determined by the balance of currents from the PMOS cascode and NMOS mirror.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure DC power, sensor drive current, and comparator switching threshold.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Testbench for Impedance Sensor Front-End
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u
.param W_xm5=5u L_xm5=0.5u
.param W_xm6=5u L_xm6=0.5u
.param W_xm7=5u L_xm7=0.5u
.param W_xm8=5u L_xm8=0.5u
.param W_xm9=5u L_xm9=0.5u
.param W_xm10=5u L_xm10=0.5u
.param W_xm11=5u L_xm11=0.5u
.param W_xm12=5u L_xm12=0.5u
.param W_xm13=5u L_xm13=0.5u
.param W_xm14=5u L_xm14=0.5u
.param W_xm15=5u L_xm15=0.5u
.param W_xm16=5u L_xm16=0.5u

XM1 N3 N5 N5 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 N5 N9 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 N1 LABEL_NET_1 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM4 N4 N10 N11 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XM5 N6 N6 N2 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm5} w={W_xm5}
XM6 N5 N3 N11 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm6} w={W_xm6}
XM7 N4 N6 N0 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm7} w={W_xm7}
XM8 N3 N1 N5 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm8} w={W_xm8}
XM9 N1 N1 N5 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm9} w={W_xm9}
XM10 N11 N8 N11 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm10} w={W_xm10}
XM11 N0 N7 N2 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm11} w={W_xm11}
XM12 N2 N4 N11 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm12} w={W_xm12}
XM13 N2 N9 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm13} w={W_xm13}
XM14 N3 N8 N3 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm14} w={W_xm14}
XM15 N11 N10 N8 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm15} w={W_xm15}
XM16 N6 LABEL_NET_2 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm16} w={W_xm16}

* Supplies and Biases
VVDD VDD 0 1.8
VLABEL_NET_1 LABEL_NET_1 0 0.9
VLABEL_NET_2 LABEL_NET_2 0 0.9
VN8 N8 0 1.8
VN10 N10 0 0.9
VN9 N9 0 0.9
VN7 N7 0 1.8

* External Sensor Impedance (50 ohms as per paper)
R_sensor N3 VDD 50

.control
  * DC Operating Point
  op
  let power = -i(VVDD) * 1.8
  let i_sensor = (1.8 - v(N3))/50
  print power
  print i_sensor

  * DC Sweep for Comparator Threshold
  dc VLABEL_NET_2 0 1.8 0.01
  meas dc comp_threshold when v(N4)=0.9

  * Transient Analysis
  tran 1u 1m
  meas tran v_n4_avg avg v(N4)
  
  quit
.endc
